name: SSHI_FBR_Zener
rationale: This design combines an SSHI (Synchronized Switch Harvesting on Inductor) circuit with a Full Bridge Rectifier (FBR) and a Zener clamp. The SSHI flips the piezoelectric capacitance voltage at the extrema, effectively increasing the harvested energy and the voltage delivered to the rectifier, which should fix the vavg and tup failures in S2 and S4. The Zener clamp (DZ33) prevents the output from exceeding 3.6V in S3, and the storage capacitor filters ripple and ensures settlement.
